purpose: Executable-test specifications and release-population contracts. These records are not test results or legal gold labels.

observation_contract.meaning: Assertion paths address a future harness observation record, not invented current NM API fields. The harness must derive them from captured served bytes, persisted state, provider spy and audit artifacts; it may not populate them from the expected values.
observation_contract.completion_rule: Every selected case and required path has one terminal result. Missing, duplicate, skipped-without-authority, unexpected, wrong-mode or changed-identity results fail the selected gate. Count selected, executed, passed, failed and not-run separately.
observation_contract.mutation_rule: Before a planted control runs, assert that the target exists, the mutation changed it and the ordinary control passed. Require the specific expected refusal, not any error or nonzero exit. Missing observations are NOT_RUN and block the dependent claim; observed false is not missing. Equality requires matching types and values, so false, zero, null and the string false cannot substitute for each other.
observation_contract.promotion_rule: A specification is never execution evidence. Scripted execution cannot satisfy real-model, counsel-review, actual-device or deployed proof. Results are separate immutable artifacts linked through the owning backlog criterion.

local_mode.name: scripted_local
allowed_data: inline invented fixtures in this catalog
locally generated synthetic media with a declared generator and hash
local_mode.providers: Scripted adapters implementing the production port, including errors, partial output and refusals. No model, OCR, email or external action service is contacted.
local_mode.capture: Record only synthetic payloads and content-free operational metadata. Place generated artifacts in an isolated per-run directory with an explicit cleanup scope.
local_mode.approval: Ordinary short deterministic tests can run under the normal build workflow. Existing per-run approval rules still apply to browser/e2e, golden, corpus/index, long load and real-model work. This catalog does not authorize those runs.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: One primary stratum and one unique matter_family_id per counted matter. Related variants and turns stay in that family and one split. Every enabled scope dimension has a declared nonempty minimum before freeze; an unrepresented enabled capability cannot inherit approval. Overlay counts do not inflate the 60.
release_portfolios.required_review: Two qualified independent reviewers for critical legal premises and outcomes; retain disagreements and adjudication. No model-generated expected answer becomes a legal gold label.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: No portfolio members, legal labels or model/counsel executions have been supplied by this plan.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: A query has one primary class; overlapping needs are secondary tags. Query families and related source versions stay in one split. Labels name the relevant set, acceptable substitutes and must-find sources; an empty relevant set requires a reviewed absence/ambiguity basis.
release_portfolios.required_review: Independent source-locator and relevance labels; legal reviewer determines must-find and applicability expectations.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: The 300 retrieval needs and independent relevant-set labels remain to be collected and frozen.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: One primary stratum per passage-task; retain enough original context to label attribution, support, treatment and applicability separately. Related passages remain in one split.
release_portfolios.required_review: Two qualified legal reviewers independently label critical cases and preserve genuine uncertainty.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: No real-source passage gold labels are authored by this synthetic catalog.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: Each field has one primary class and an original page/span/time coordinate. Publish fields, distinct assets and matter-family counts separately; many fields from one asset do not imply many independent assets. Every enabled format/language cell needs a nonempty reviewed sample.
release_portfolios.required_review: Double-check material labels against originals; distinguish flagged uncertainty from correctly extracted values.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: Source media and independently checked field labels are not yet populated.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: At least two tenants and one excluded same-firm actor. Enumerate routes, workers, sinks and stores from the deployed inventory; every relevant discovered surface needs a test or a reviewed nonapplicability reason. One hundred is a floor, not a cap or proof of complete attack coverage.
release_portfolios.required_review: Independent high-risk security review and remediation retest on the target deployment; local scripted ports cannot satisfy it.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: The deployed surface inventory and 100-scenario attack portfolio have not been assembled or executed.

release_portfolios.membership_rule: Count each participant once; repeated tasks are observations, not new users. Recruit genuine assistive-technology users for those sessions with consent and accessibility support. Eight to twelve is a formative research target, not a statistically representative production claim.
release_portfolios.required_review: A facilitator predeclares tasks and rubric, records failures and assistance, and does not coach a failed task into a pass.
release_portfolios.blocking_reason: No participants have been recruited or sessions observed by this plan.

portfolio_validation.specification_check: Validate nonempty portfolio definitions, positive minima, unique IDs, primary minima summing to minimum_count, owner criterion references, required fields and nonempty review protocols. Empty members are an honest planned state, not a structural error.
portfolio_validation.release_check: For every portfolio required by the selected enabled scope, refuse empty or undersized members, missing/duplicate families, unmet primary or overlay minima, unrepresented enabled dimensions, missing rights or labels, unresolved critical disagreement, data leakage across splits, missing execution evidence or incompatible identity/mode. Minimum counts come from the approved frozen plan and cannot be reduced by editing expected counts during a run.
portfolio_validation.actual_member_rule: Members are real populated fixture/reviewer records, not generated placeholder IDs. A synthetic spec or an empty template does not count toward a held-out source or participant population.
portfolio_validation.change_control: Before first approved run freeze and hash the portfolio manifest, scope matrix, labels, thresholds and exclusions. Any later reduction or removed failure requires a new scope decision and independent review; retain the former manifest and results. No automatic shrink-to-pass behavior.

manual_review_protocols.reviewer_role: two qualified practising Indian advocates for the enabled scope plus an adjudicator when needed
required_inputs: blind output packages and critical-failure definitions
tasks: Independently identify applicable law, jurisdiction, legal vintage, burden and governing premises
Check quotations, speaker, ratio/submission distinction, treatment, adverse material and applicability separately
Assess missing controlling facts, useful questioning, remedies, enforceability, proportionality and respectful disagreement
Review conditional calculations only after their premises; record unsettled issues rather than forcing agreement
Score applicable PA standards and task adequacy; adjudicate material disagreements without deleting original labels
failure_conditions: any unresolved critical legal failure
scope not supported by reviewed primary sources
missing qualified reviewer
rubric or thresholds selected after seeing results

manual_review_protocols.reviewer_role: qualified India privacy/legal owner with responsible product and security owners
required_inputs: dated operative instruments and commencement analysis
purposes, legal roles, client permissions and third-party data boundaries
retention, holds, rights and incident plans
tasks: Map each processing purpose to the responsible legal role and applicable permission or obligation
Determine which notified provisions are operative on the planned release date
Review storage, processing, backups, logs, support locations and fallback endpoints separately
Review media authority, restricted/privileged material and children or special-category scenarios
Approve or reject category-specific retention, deletion and reporting clocks with reasons
failure_conditions: unapproved processor or unexplained data flow
global-compliance claim without a scoped determination
blanket immediate-erasure promise inconsistent with holds or backups
unassigned incident responsibility

manual_review_protocols.reviewer_role: independent risk-scoped security assessor and release owner
required_inputs: key, support and CI access policies
tasks: Verify every discovered entry path against tenant, matter, role and assurance policy
Exercise replay, fixation, recovery, factor downgrade and revocation through actual devices and the selected provider
Inspect before-provider filtering, private logs, parser isolation and egress restrictions
Test key unavailability, rotation, object substitution and emergency access
Independently reproduce high-risk findings and inspect remediation on the release identity
failure_conditions: unauthorised disclosure or action
unresolved high-impact isolation, key or recovery defect
scripted proof substituted for deployed control
uninspected relevant entry point without reviewed nonapplicability

manual_review_protocols.reviewer_role: operations incident commander, security/legal owner and independent recovery witness
tasks: Restore the selected deployment into isolation and reconcile permissions and deletion before reopening
Measure RPO and RTO against acknowledged records and actual elapsed time
Simulate reportable incident assessment with incomplete facts and an unavailable primary contact
Measure queue saturation, cancellation, provider/key outages and fairness at the approved workload
Rehearse rollback with pending jobs and target-only writes; reject incompatible rollback
failure_conditions: missed approved recovery objective without a new approved narrower scope
revived erased data or stale permission
unowned or missed escalation
silent data loss or duplicate external effects
unbounded load/cost or wrong build identity

manual_review_protocols.reviewer_role: user researcher or trained facilitator with representative practising advocates
required_inputs: supported device widths and assistive conditions
artifact identity and synthetic task data
tasks: Ask each participant to identify active firm, matter, saved state and current advice
Ask them to provide a brief by their permitted input mode, correct it, pause and resume
Ask them to inspect a source, adverse fact, uncertainty, missing information and next action without coaching
Ask them to understand an outage, recover a session and log out
Record unassisted result, errors, help and critical misunderstanding at each declared accessibility condition
failure_conditions: critical uncertainty or workspace confusion
a required task inaccessible in an enabled condition
assisted completion reported as unassisted
participant or task population empty
